latest.title: The Saito determinant for extended affine Weyl discriminant strata
latest.abstract: We investigate the form of the Saito metric on quotients of the reflection representation of an extended affine Weyl group, restricted to an arbitrary stratum of its discriminant. We compute the Saito determinant for all strata and Dynkin types and show that it is divisible by a product of q-analogues of restricted roots for the associated hyperplane arrangement. Our results simultaneously generalise the factorisation in the Weyl denominator formula to higher codimension strata, and provide q-analogue refinements of results of Antoniou-Feigin-Strachan for Coxeter groups.
latest.progressType: 统一因子分解与显式计算
latest.workSummary: 计算扩张仿射 Weyl 群轨道空间中，文中所定义判别分层上的 Saito 度量行列式，给出所有 Dynkin 类型的三角型限制根因子分解。经典型由 Landau–Ginzburg 超势直接计算，例外型结合 Jacobian 子式与低维显式计算处理。
latest.breakthrough: 把 Weyl 分母型分解延伸到高余维分层，并给出有限 Coxeter 结果的 q-类比细化；扩张仿射情形的指数不再简单等同于 Coxeter 数。
latest.limitations: 分层采用文中的根超平面与抛物根子系统约定；不能不加辨别地推广至所有不共轭的仿射镜面交。部分例外型依赖附带 Wolfram notebook，本次未运行这些计算。
latest.priorityReason: 统一公式与可复用计算对 Frobenius 流形、可积系统有价值；但主要入口是表示论及专门分层计算，先排在直接解决几何核心问题的论文之后。
